description: Zone-based credential governance policies for the Credential Oversharing Detector

regulatoryContext.Low: Informational finding in developer environment. Document for governance awareness.
regulatoryContext.Medium: Review recommended per GLBA 501(b) access management guidelines.
regulatoryContext.Informational: No action required. Logged for audit trail.

regulatoryContext.High: Required review per SOX Section 404 access control requirements and GLBA 501(b).
regulatoryContext.Medium: Review recommended per OCC 2011-12 operational risk management guidelines.
regulatoryContext.Low: Document finding for periodic governance review.

regulatoryContext.Critical: Immediate remediation required. Supports compliance with FINRA Rule 4511(a) record-keeping and SEC 17a-4 access controls. Escalate to CISO.
regulatoryContext.High: Required review within 24 hours per SOX Section 302/404 and OCC 2011-12 model risk management.
regulatoryContext.Medium: Review within 1 business week per GLBA 501(b) safeguards rule.

regulatoryContext.High: Environment zone classification missing. Treat as restricted until classified. Review per governance policy.

settingDescriptions.OverprivilegedConnector: Agent uses a connector with permissions exceeding its declared operating scope.
settingDescriptions.ExcessiveOAuthScope: Agent connector requests more OAuth scopes than the zone policy allows.
settingDescriptions.UnauthorizedServiceAccount: Agent uses a service account or app registration not approved for its zone.
settingDescriptions.CrossEnvironmentCredential: Agent credentials are shared across multiple environments violating isolation policy.
settingDescriptions.SharedCredentialMisuse: Multiple agents share the same credential when individual credentials are required by zone policy.
settingDescriptions.StaleCredentialAccess: Agent uses credentials that exceed the maximum age defined by zone policy.
